cases.input: One logical service is placed by two deployment occurrences into EU and US runtime environments.
cases.expect: One WM-SFT-002 identity, two WM-SFT-009 occurrences and two WM-SFT-010 environments remain distinct.

cases.input: Node N1 is retired at T2 and N2 replaces it before T3.
cases.expect: T1 impact returns N1 and old occupant records; T3 returns N2 and successors with N1 tombstone retained.

cases.input: The same IP address is later assigned to another tenant resource.
cases.expect: Resources remain distinct because address is an effective-dated observation, not identity.

cases.input: One topology source is stale or unavailable.
cases.expect: Impact reports incomplete coverage rather than no impact.

cases.input: One owned chassis is capitalized and also under configuration control.
cases.expect: Physical item, asset record, resource and CI designation remain distinct and linked by effective evidence.

cases.input: All nodes of a logical cluster are replaced.
cases.expect: Cluster identity remains stable while membership edges close and reopen.

cases.input: Declared desired version differs from discovered running version.
cases.expect: Both assertions and drift remain visible; neither silently overwrites the other.

cases.input: A runtime replica key is proposed as a second identity for the logical service.
cases.expect: The key remains a dependent RuntimeOccupantRecord correlation key bound to WM-SFT-002 and WM-SFT-009.

cases.input: One deployment occurrence produces four concurrent runtime occupants.
cases.expect: All four dependent records reference the same occurrence without becoming independent service masters.

cases.input: A new deployment occurrence replaces occupants while the logical system remains unchanged.
cases.expect: New dependent occupant records bind to the new occurrence; the WM-SFT-002 identity is unchanged.

cases.input: A node member-of edge is supplied where an occupant runs-on edge is required.
cases.expect: Endpoint rules reject the relation-kind substitution.

cases.input: Configuration control is withdrawn from an environment.
cases.expect: The designation closes while the environment subject survives.

cases.input: A resource is equated to an asset using only a matching display name.
cases.expect: The merge is rejected because effective-dated identity evidence is missing.

cases.input: A tombstone has no pinned governing retention policy.
cases.expect: The record is retained and the history guarantee is marked pending rather than assumed unbounded.

cases.input: Two regional environments are collapsed because they host the same service.
cases.expect: The environments remain distinct; service identity and region classification do not replace environment identity.

cases.expect: reject key reuse; retain the closed occupant
